notebook: Feed 3300 mol/s, 16 comps C2(184.6K)..C9(424K), all-pure $3615M/yr. Blends are contiguous in boiling order: C3mix(propyl+propane), C4mix(iC4+nC4), C5mix(iC5+nC5), C6paraffin(22DMB+2MP+3MP+nC6), C6naphthene(MCP+cyclohexane). Natural train: C2 / C3mix / C4mix / C5mix / C6par / C6naph / C7 / C8 / C9 = 9 groups, 8 splits. Cost: fixed ~$70-90M/col dominates; 15st/r1=$95M, 30st/r2=$146M, 40st/r3=$195M. 5 stages fails converge; keep >=15. Hardest split: 3MP/nC6 (~336-342) vs MCP (345) = 3 K. Easiest: ethane/C3mix (40 K). Note ethane is only 34 mol/s (~1%) and worth just $4M - may be best to leave/dump it rather than spend a column. Revenue MUST come from >=95% streams; empty/iMPa design scores 0 but any single column with no pure product is negative. Plan: build a train of ~7-8 columns producing the contiguous blend cuts, keep every column converged, measure revenue vs cost, then tune reflux/stages to hit 95% (and 99% for 1.2x premium) where profitable.
